jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst
jobs.description:
What is Cream all about ?

 

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues :)
Your future projects

Like Morgane, Business Analyst at Cream, you work close to business & IT teams and work on applications. Your tasks will be :

• Communicate with the different stakeholders in order to understand their requirements

• Translate business requirements into detailed business specifications for IT

• Analyze the impact due to required evolutions

• Perform impact analysis of new processes and determine the gaps between as-is and to-be situations

• Design and document the to-be process

• Organize the Test strategy and follow up the testing

• Coordinate and communicate with the different stakeholders

• Change management and deployment

• Adapt yourself to the new environment of our clients

What do we expect from our consultant ?

• You have at least 2 years of experience in Business or Process analysis

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables

• You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• An experience in project management methodologies (Prince 2, PMI, Agile...) and tools (Balsamiq, Clarity, Jira, Azure, Enterprise Architect...) could be a real asset

• A knowledge of Business Process Modeling (ARIS, Visio, Camounda, UML, ...)

Robert Half is currently looking for a PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) for a company located in the Beringen region.

Our client is an international organization with a well-established European hub in Belgium. The company operates in a fast-moving and structured environment, supporting large-scale operations across multiple countries while maintaining a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The responsibilities for this job as PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) include:

• You take on a pan-European finance controlling role within an international finance team.
• You support financial reporting and controlling activities in close collaboration with local and international stakeholders.
• You report directly to the Finance Manager and contribute to the follow-up of key finance processes.
• You help ensure accurate analysis, reporting, and financial follow-up in an English-speaking business environment.
• You contribute to month-end closing activities and are prepared to provide extra support during the first working days of the month.

• You combine strong analytical skills with the ability to work independently.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office in your daily work.
• You are a professional and respectful communicator with a strong work ethic.
• You have a mature, proactive, and hands-on mindset.
• You feel comfortable in a structured environment.
• You bring experience with SAP, IFRS, VAT, corporate tax, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, or external audits as an advantage.
• You are motivated by working in an international and multicultural environment.

To strengthen our Global IT team, Manuchar is looking for a technically curious and solution-oriented 
Service Desk Engineer. Based at our headquarters in 
Antwerp (Merksem), you will support colleagues worldwide and help ensure they can work efficiently with the right IT tools and systems.
 

You will join an international IT environment where no two days are the same. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, takes initiative and is eager to further develop their IT expertise.
 

Key Responsibilities

• Troubleshoot issues involving Microsoft 365, Windows, hardware, networks, servers and internally developed applications.

• You have a solid understanding of 
Microsoft 365 and Windows environments. Knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Active Directory, Windows Autopilot, networking or server infrastructure is a plus. 

• You have strong troubleshooting skills and enjoy investigating technical issues independently.

• You are hands-on, take initiative and are eager to further develop your technical expertise.

• You are fluent in 
English. Knowledge of Dutch or Spanish is an advantage.  

What We Offer

• An attractive compensation package including hospitalization and group insurance, meal vouchers, mobile phone with subscription, collective bonus, and more.

Can't wait to join our team?
 

Send your CV and cover letter through our online recruitment tool, Talent Recruiter.
 

Questions? Contact Lise Polfliet, HR Assistant, at recruitment@manuchar.com.
 

Manuchar, a multinational of Belgian origin
 

Manuchar is a leading distributor of chemicals across high-growth markets and also trades commodities such as steel and polymers. With more than 40 years of local presence and over 180 locations worldwide, we provide end-to-end commercial, supply chain and financing solutions.
 

Our mission:“Connecting the World. For Better Lives."

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

Already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges, and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium (in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges) and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

Join Michael Page as a Recruiter and play a key role in connecting top talent with leading companies across Belgium. You will manage the full recruitment cycle while building long-term relationships with both candidates and clients.

Client Details

Michael Page is one of the world's leading specialized recruitment firms, operating in more than 35 countries. We offer a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where ambition, performance, and personal development are truly valued.

Description

• Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for permanent positions.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with candidates and clients.
• Source, screen, and interview qualified professionals.
• Advise clients on market trends, salary benchmarks, and hiring strategies.
• Negotiate offers and support candidates throughout the hiring process.
• Contribute to business development and identify new opportunities within your market.

• Bachelor's degree minimum.
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and business development.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
• Proactive, ambitious, and results-oriented personality.
• Previous experience in recruitment, sales, customer service, or business development is a plus.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 

• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Between 5 to 15 stops/day

• Never on weekends or on holidays

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby + truck cannot be taken home)

Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 4 December. You will be working in the night shift (22u00 - 06u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 21u10 

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Our client is a leading Belgian construction and engineering group active in construction, real estate development and concessions.

With an international presence and approximately 10,000 employees across more than 25 countries, the company delivers complex construction and infrastructure projects in Belgium and abroad.

 

As a Project Buyer, you are responsible for managing procurement activities within an assigned scope of construction projects. Working closely with the project teams, you ensure that works, supplies and services are purchased under the best possible conditions, while taking into account technical requirements, project planning, costs, risks and QHSES standards.

You report to the Head Buyer and work in close collaboration with the various project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage procurement activities independently within your assigned scope.
• Handle the full procurement process, from defining the sourcing strategy and preparing requests for quotation to negotiating and finalizing contracts.
• Advise project teams on procurement matters and provide input on market conditions and sourcing opportunities.
• Work closely with multidisciplinary teams, including engineering, design, construction planning, finance, legal and procurement specialists.
• Identify and engage with potential subcontractors, suppliers and service providers.
• Prepare requests for quotation based on technical and operational requirements provided by the project teams.
• Analyze and compare offers from both a technical and financial perspective.
• Organize clarification meetings and lead commercial negotiations.
• Support project teams in the supplier selection and award decision process.
• Ensure proper contract documentation and administrative follow-up.

Your Profile

We are open to candidates with either a technical background in civil engineering or previous experience in procurement:

Civil Engineering / Construction background

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering or a related technical discipline.
• You have a solid understanding of civil works and are interested in developing your career towards procurement and purchasing.
• Exposure to construction projects, technical coordination, subcontractors, tendering or cost estimation would be an asset.
Procurement / Buyer background

• Alternatively, you have previous experience in procurement or purchasing within the construction or civil engineering sector.
• You are familiar with sourcing, subcontracting, supplier management and contract negotiations.
• You have a good understanding of procurement processes and contract administration.
Regardless of your background, you bring:

• A strong interest in construction procurement and the commercial aspects of projects.
• A good understanding of civil works, particularly concrete, reinforcement, formwork and post-tensioning, or the ability to develop this knowledge.
• Excellent level of Dutch, both written and spoken (mandatory), and a good command of English.
• Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills.
• The ability to work collaboratively with technical and operational stakeholders.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

Our client is a family-owned industrial company based in Alken (Belgium), specialized in solutions for industrial electric motors, gearmotors, pumps, and fans. They are currently looking for an experienced CNC Programmer / Operator to join their production team.The company offers a solid onboarding program, giving you time to adapt and grow into the role.In this position, you will work in a technical production environment where precision, programming, and machine knowledge are key.Your responsibilities include:
• Setting up cutting tools, positioning, and clamping workpieces
• Setting machining parameters (speed, feed, lubrication, etc.)
• Operating and programming CNC milling machines
• Making adjustments and modifications to machining programs

We are looking for a skilled and motivated CNC professional:
• Minimum 2 years of experience in CNC machining

• Good level of English

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
A growing company that packages and stores frozen and chilled food products to order for European customers.
